seo_description: Samuel Bahago Gabriel is a geospatial analyst specializing in GIS, remote sensing and spatial modelling for environmental, engineering and planning decisions.

hero.eyebrow: GIS · Remote sensing · Spatial modelling · Hydrology
hero.lead: I use GIS, remote sensing and spatial modelling to turn complex geographic data into clear maps, reliable analysis and practical evidence for planning, engineering and environmental decisions.
hero.summary: My work spans water resources, catchment management, flood and erosion risk, infrastructure, land-use change, groundwater investigations and environmental assessments across Nigeria.
hero.portrait_alt: Professional portrait of Samuel Bahago Gabriel

featured.heading: Spatial evidence for real decisions.

work.heading: Earth science informs the analysis. Clear communication makes it useful.
paragraphs: I combine satellite imagery, terrain models, field evidence and stakeholder knowledge to build defensible spatial products.
My goal is not simply to produce maps, but to explain patterns, support planning and make technical evidence accessible.

contact.heading: Have a spatial problem worth solving?
contact.intro: I welcome geospatial analysis, remote sensing, spatial modelling and multidisciplinary project opportunities.
